reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount, but the rewritten approximate branch still inlines Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: No new copies of the schedule rule are created; the only duplication is the 7.5% tolerance expression the edited line keeps re-stating instead of sharing.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts, the single definition all schedule amount consumers use.

scope.why: Only the helper's two expressions and its tests change.

maintainability.why: A two-line change in one function with updated tests is easy to own; the inlined tolerance constant can drift from the rules engine's threshold.
